reported_status: The P1 producer reports a positive predictor and finite-horizon complete-record certificate for a specified interacting-boson model with replenishing thermal gain and loss. The report also gives a stationary example in which pooled counts agree while output-port labels distinguish future records. Its attachment previews/downloads did not yield the named technical originals; those files remain unavailable.

This is separate from the weak-bath N927 contract, ordinary loss N928, and the replenished classical-field result N941.
